Mark Webber drove for Williams in 2006. The race reports for the 2006 Bahrain Grand Prix (6th place) and the 2006 Spanish Grand Prix (9th place) both list him with Williams. I didn't run a season-standings search, so this rests on those two races rather than the full season.

ANSWER: Williams
